_about: Dates and descriptions for the photos on the Blog page (/blog/). Photos come from the final blog post (images/...) and from Legacy/Public/Blog Photos/ ("Blog Photos/<file name>"). A photo doesn't need to be listed here to show up: list it only to give it a "description" (shown under the photo when it's opened, and read out by screen readers) or a "date" (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it was taken) when the photo's own camera data and file name don't have one. The grid runs oldest to newest; on the website each photo is named after its date (2024-06-28.webp; a second photo from the same day becomes 2024-06-28-2.webp).
